title: NLData2Opt: Benchmarking Parameter Derivation and Prediction for Modeling Optimization Problems from Natural Language and Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.22889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formulating optimization problems from raw inputs of problem descriptions and data is time-consuming and costly. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising way to automate this process, existing benchmarks overestimate their capabilities by relying on idealized inputs where all data is relevant and complete. This diverges from reality, where data-centric reasoning is required to extract, compute, and predict parameters from noisy sources. To address this, we introduce NLData2Opt, a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on the multi-stage reasoning inherent in practical optimization workflows. NLData2Opt decomposes problems into problem descriptions and data, and requires models to (1) extract relevant parameters from data containing misleading attributes, (2) compute missing parameters derived by transforming existing data attributes, and (3) predict unavailable future values from historical observations. translated_title: NLData2Opt：基于自然语言与数据的优化问题建模中参数推导与预测的基准测试
translated_abstract: 从问题描述和数据的原始输入中构建优化问题是耗时且成本高昂的。虽然大语言模型（LLM）为自动化这一过程提供了一条有前景的途径，但现有的基准测试依赖于所有数据都相关且完整的理想化输入，从而高估了模型的能力。这与现实情况存在偏差——现实中需要进行以数据为中心的推理，才能从含噪声的数据源中提取、计算和预测参数。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 NLData2Opt，一个用于评估大语言模型在实际优化工作流程中固有的多阶段推理能力的基准。NLData2Opt 将问题分解为问题描述和数据两部分，并要求模型（1）从包含误导性属性的数据中提取相关参数，（2）通过转换现有数据属性来推导计算缺失的参数，以及（3）根据历史观测数据预测不可得的未来数值。评估结果显示……
tldr: 该论文提出了 NLData2Opt 基准，要求大语言模型从含噪声的真实数据中完成优化问题参数的提取、推导计算和未来值预测，弥补了现有基准依赖理想化输入而高估模型实际能力的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NLData2Opt, a benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to extract, derive, and predict optimization problem parameters from noisy real-world data, addressing the overestimation caused by existing benchmarks' reliance on idealized inputs.
